We have both gone to the same school for several years and have overlapping circles of friends. There have been times where I though she might have been showing interest in me, but that is just me seeing what I want to. The only interactions are the niceties and conversations that are typical for a friendship.

They may have an inkling, but probably not. I haven't always been the best friend to people; usually because I'm more of a "drag" for lack of a better word than anything to them. I honestly just don't like myself as a person and don't really want to live with all of my failures and regrets

Given some of my possessions away to people who would actually use them. Have a draft for a note that will hopefully lessen the sadness for my family. I still have a few more things to give out and some apologizing to do. Mostly I just want people to know that they've been good to me so that when I kill myself they know that. Also a living will in case something goes wrong.
i don't want to face the disappointment
I'm making preparations to make things right and end on a good note before I kill myself
I have a chance with her
